editorial:
Imagine graduating from college only to find out that the job market is a total nightmare. That is exactly where you find Hima, a guy who ends up driving a school bus just to get by. He calls himself the King of Generation, and honestly, his confidence is the best part of the movie. You will love the vibe here because it is all about a regular guy trying to win over a beautiful teacher. The problem is that she is already being chased by a wealthy, mean businessman who thinks money can buy everything. It is a classic battle of heart versus wallet, and the comedy comes from Hima trying to act cool while dealing with chaotic kids on his bus.

The acting is lighthearted and the pacing keeps you smiling throughout the whole ride. While some of the jokes are a bit silly, that is exactly what makes it feel like a fun weekend watch. It is a perfect pick for anyone who needs a good laugh and a feel-good story.
endingExplained: In the final act, Hima proves that his kind heart is worth more than the businessman's money. After a series of funny mishaps and confrontations, the teacher realizes that Hima truly cares for her and makes her laugh. She rejects the evil businessman and chooses to be with the King of Generation. The movie wraps up with Hima winning the girl and finding happiness, showing that being yourself is the best way to get the girl.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted romantic comedies and underdog stories.
